compartment.definition: The space external to the outermost structure of a cell. For cells without external protective or external encapsulating structures this refers to space outside of the plasma membrane. This term covers the host cell environment outside an intracellular parasite.
compartment.name: extracellular region

disease.definition: A tauopathy that results in progressive memory loss, impaired thinking, disorientation, and changes in personality and mood starting and leads in advanced cases to a profound decline in cognitive and physical functioning and is marked histologically by the degeneration of brain neurons especially in the cerebral cortex and by the presence of neurofibrillary tangles and plaques containing beta-amyloid. It is characterized by memory lapses, confusion, emotional instability and progressive loss of mental ability.
name: Alzheimer's disease

summation.displayName: The interaction between amyloid beta (Aβ) peptide aggregates...
summation.text: The interaction between amyloid beta (Aβ) peptide aggregates and fibrin or fibrinogen results in the formation of abnormal blood clots that are more stable and resistant to fibrinolysis. This process may contribute to the vascular pathology observed in Alzheimer's disease. The Aβ peptides described here are APP(672-711) and APP(672-713).
